roles.title: Assistant Manager
roles.text: Help run the Hammersmith Belle: match days, beach-hut parties, Sunday roasts and thirteen new rooms upstairs.

roles.title: Supervisor
roles.text: Lead a shift at the Griffin in Vauxhall, from breakfast for hotel guests to the final whistle.

perks: Training for everyone on our standards, steps of service, menus and products, with more for anyone newer to the trade
Competitive pay plus service charge and tips
A quarterly bonus scheme for salaried managers
A free meal and soft drinks on every shift
Room to grow with a company that's still growing
lookingFor: Energy, enthusiasm, a sense of humour and a winning smile. Experience helps; attitude matters more.
